title: Purpose registry
description: Validates metadata/consent/purpose-registry/*.yaml. Every handler that reads protected data declares a purpose id from this registry; CI rejects unregistered purposes, and the consent engine evaluates the declared purpose against each record's consent scope.

id.description: Immutable once published — audit records reference the purpose a request declared.

label.description: Written for the person whose data it is. This string is shown in the consent dashboard, so it must read as a reason, not as a system description.

consent.description: explicit requires an affirmative, withdrawable grant. implied-by-service is covered by using the service at all. not-required covers safety, legal and contractual processing. override proceeds against stated preference and is reserved for vital-interest cases.

ai_permitted.description: Whether the AI tier may process data under this purpose. False means no model in any zone may receive it.

then.description: An explicit consent must state whether it can be withdrawn.
Overriding a user's stated preference is permitted only on vital-interest grounds, and the conditions must be written down.
